strings.name: Sebastian Vettel
strings.role: Racing driver · Four-time Formula One world champion
strings.summary: Vettel progressed from karting and junior formulae to four consecutive drivers' titles with Red Bull from 2010 to 2013 and 53 Grand Prix victories. He first won with Toro Rosso, later raced for Ferrari and Aston Martin, and ended his F1 career in 2022. Before and after retirement he advocated environmental protection, biodiversity and social equality, receiving The Perfect World Foundation Award in 2026.
